categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies `scanblocks` handling in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents silent data omission in `scanblocks` where unindexed filter ranges caused the RPC to return a false 'complete' status with missing matches. Callers previously had 'no way to distinguish "no matches" from "range was never scanned"', risking missed transactions.
